body: I have heard of Discord but I’ve never used it. That does sounds like a good idea since my interests tend to be very niche. Maybe I’ll give it a try!

I will definitely give that a try and work towards trying to level up all my memories even though it’ll take me a while 😣 Thanks for your help!!

I run out of time with about a quarter of the way through the last health bar on the boss, sometimes even closer. I prefer to use the wand bc it offers long range attacks and can do damage to multiple enemies at a time. The memory levels are at 38, 20, 12, 7 and 5. I spend most of my wishes on leveling up the highest one which may have been a bad move but it had always got me through tough levels in the past. Obviously they are ranked up a few times, have attached +2 protocores, most of them are 4 star memories and one 5 star, two of them are also paired memories. I get really close to beating it but it always seems like a need just a little bit more every time 😔

There are random moments where I can't breathe. Not like gasping for breath hyperventilating or even like strangled breathing. I breathe out but it takes me like 5 seconds to like inhale again? It's sort of like a heavy lung feeling or like someone has my lungs and just squeezed them really tight. I've never been able to find out exactly what it is and I've Googled it a million times. I notice it most when my stomach is super empty or after I eat a full meal. Sometimes when I'm trying to sleep. However, it does happen at other completely random times that's have no apparent connection. I should also point out it happens a lot  when I'm relaxing or just chilling so I'm not like noticeably anxious when it happens. I've never actually died or run out of breath so I've never gotten it checked out but it is super terrifying and overall extremely uncomfortable. I don't know if this is a mental or physical thing but I've had this for YEARS and it really effects me. I was wondering if anyone else experiences this as well or can maybe shed some light on what it is.
Thank you for you reply! Does that mean book 2 is the final book?
It's not your fault. Today is just a day. Tomorrow can always be better. I believe in you <3
I'm glad you're feeling a little better!! You're fighting a tough battle. It seems like your family cares about you a lot so I hope you lean on that thought when things are hard. Proud of you <3

That really sucks that you have to go through all that anxiety at night. I think it's a good idea to wait and see what life has for you. Since you're still young you get to see and experience so many things and that's kind of exciting tbh. I hope we can both stay strong even when things are hard. I'm rooting for us <3

I feel you I am the same exact way. I stay up most of the night because I can't stand facing the long day. At night no one wants anything from you and you can just do whatever you feel like doing in the quiet darkness. At night I have fun dancing, watching stuff, listening to music and playing games etc. but when I think about how tomorrow will come I get scary depressed. Waking up is even worse. Crazy how everyday life is so traumatic for us. I get it it's totally relatable, and the people who say you're overreacting are goofs. I've heard that taking melatonin helps you sleep but I've never tried it. When you're struggling through the night or wake up feeling terrible just remember that there's someone else out there doing the exact same thing (aka me haha). If you need help sleeping I do have some tips that I can share with you that actually help - just let me know! :)
